At StreetWorks Exotics, a flawless finish begins long before the first drop of paint is atomized. We strip every chassis down to bare metal, meticulously blocking and sanding to ensure the structural lines flow exactly as the original designers intended.

We specialize in period-correct color matching, utilizing advanced multi-stage clear coats to provide a depth and luster that will command attention on the lawn at Pebble Beach or the open road.

Our team at StreetWorks Exotics has earned a stellar reputation in the world of high-end car paint shops by delivering impeccable finishes, precise bodywork, perfect panel gaps, and flawless paint jobs.

Whether you need classic car trunk paint repair or all-over Italian sports car paint, StreetWorks offers nothing less than perfection. We understand that you won’t settle for anything less, nor will we!

seo.description: StreetWorks Exotics has made a name in automobile restoration body & paint: finest finishes, the straightest bodywork, perfect panel gaps & flawless paint.
